goal: 24/7 forward-OOS gate, live compounding, trailing drawdown breaker.

capacity_decision.recommendation: Keep max_concurrent_crypto=2. Observed peak concurrency is 2 in-sample and 1 out-of-sample, so a fourth slot adds no filled trades; it only doubles the worst simultaneous stop from $13.00 to $26.00 against a ~$32.80 buffer. The two-slot cap never binds on the OOS tape.

supervision.cadence: hourly gate / 15-minute live checks / 6-hour cache rebuild

done.layagate_non_blocking: openkal/decision_gate.py caches one verdict per ticker and refreshes it in a background task (15s or a 2c mid move). openkal/engine.py reads that cache on the entry path: a dict read, 0ms, no connection opened. Params.require_layagate_allow / layagate_min_confidence turn the cached opinion into a hard filter with no code edit.
done.student_t_l2_settle: openkal/features.py: exact Student-t CDF (continued fraction), per-lane frozen (nu, s), tau_eff = max(secs_left - 40, 1), true-L2 imbalance, signed aggressor flow on a fast and a slow window. openkal/strategy.py: the 0.35-0.60 band under the 0.62 hard cap, OBI and flow aligned with the side, T+1s entry, hold to settlement for a $0 exit fee. openkal/engine.py can run it when Params.strategy_mode says so; F2_taker_1s stays the default.
done.forward_scorer: scripts/forward_oos.py --strategy student_t_l2_settle scores the program on the same forward slice through openkal/sim_core.py only, with the production strategy deciding the entries. Artifact: data/forward-oos-student-t-l2.json.
done.tests: tests/test_live_exit.py: 125/125 checks (was 97). New: 0ms cached gate reads with the HTTP client booby-trapped, require_layagate_allow on/off, offline gate, minimum confidence, Student-t quantiles, the imbalance, the band, the 0.62 cap, the OBI and flow alignment, and the hold-to-settlement exit.
